text: Gardening entails nurturing plants to ensure their health and growth. Watering is the primary step, as it keeps the soil moist and provides the necessary moisture for the roots to absorb and store. Pruning is another important step that involves removing dead, diseased, or damaged branches to promote healthy growth and prevent the spread of pests and diseases. Additionally, pruning helps control the plant size and encourages the development of new, stronger stems. Proper watering and pruning enable your garden to flourish and serve as a haven for butterflies, bees, and other pollinators.
